description: Get the list of planned maintenance schedules in Cloud Insight (paged). The API requires a filter: either a time range (from/to/timeType) OR a resource (resourceId+productKey). If none is given, a default ±180-day window by startTime is applied.

from.description: Filter start (epoch ms), used with 'to' and 'timeType'

productKey.description: Filter by product key (use together with resourceId)

resourceId.description: Filter by resource ID (use together with productKey instead of a time range)

timeType.description: Which time the from/to filter applies to (default startTime)

name: ncloud_list_maintenances
